name: Differentiable Volumetric Rendering — Uses surface rendering, computes gradients analytically, and performs inference via a CNN encoder.
definition: A 3D-aware generative model trained on a few unposed 2D images of a single scene to generate diverse 3D radiance fields that preserve appearance while varying scene layout.
summary: Differentiable Volumetric Rendering uses surface rendering, computes gradients analytically, and performs inference via a CNN encoder.
